info.name: Mini LMS API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Mini LMS REST API.

Base URL: {{base_url}}

Setup:
1. Import this collection.
2. Create a Postman environment named 'Mini LMS Local' with:
   - base_url  = http://localhost:8000/api
   - access_token  = (auto-filled after Login)
   - refresh_token = (auto-filled after Login)
3. Run 'Auth > Login' first — tokens are automatically stored.

Project: AVGC XR Solutions Technical Assessment
Version: 1.0.0
